findings.claim: Case B on Claude Code relies on PreToolUse allow + updatedInput.command for Bash. v1 already found that Claude Code ignores this: the original command ran unchanged. The ADR does not cite this and plans case B as the main Claude Code path.
findings.evidence: cm-main hooks/core/formatters.mjs:23-28 'CC v2.1.x ignores `updatedInput.command` substitution under `permissionDecision: "allow"` — original command runs unchanged'. round3-evidence.json E1 note: 'One live run is still needed.'
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 4bc292fc 2026-05-31 'fix(hooks): claude-code Bash modify → deny (CC ignores updatedInput.command)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'the redirects silently no-op'd in production: users ran curl ..., got the raw HTML ... high-impact regression'. REGRESSION_RISK: v2 case B re-ships the same silent no-op; subagent contexts flood, breaking the ADR-0016 MUST. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep deny for Bash until LV1 passes on the pinned CC version.
findings.fix: Cite 4bc292fc in ADR-0016 and ADR-0008. Make case C (or deny with a Bash alternative) the Claude Code row by default; switch to case B only after LV1 passes on 2.1.283, recorded in the adapter table.

findings.claim: PRD says every hook is one command entry 'context-mode hook <agent> <event>'. ADR-0008 #4 says the Claude Code PreToolUse hook is type mcp_tool with no process. One doc must change.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:102 'One entry: `context-mode hook <agent> <event>`'; adr/0008:27 'Claude Code: the PreToolUse hook is `type:"mcp_tool"`'. Also PRD-v2.md:189 'no user CLI and no npm' conflicts with a `context-mode` bin.
findings.fix: Update PRD §6: Claude Code PreToolUse = mcp_tool (server context-mode, tool ctx_route); other events and agents = `node <bundle>/hook.mjs <agent> <event>`. Name ctx_route in the tool list or mark it hidden.

findings.claim: The mcp_tool hook was proven only with a stub server added by --mcp-config (server 'ctx'). v2 ships as a plugin. It is not shown that a plugin hooks.json mcp_tool entry can address the plugin's own server, nor what server name it must use.
findings.evidence: round4-evidence.json F13 live3: 'USE ToolSearch {"query":"select:mcp__ctx__ctx_execute"}' (plain server 'ctx'). TECH-SPEC.md:186 plugin tool name is 'mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute', so the server id differs in plugin mode.
findings.fix: Add live check: plugin loaded via --plugin-dir, hooks.json PreToolUse type mcp_tool, assert ctx_route is called. Record the exact server field in the adapter table.

findings.claim: Hook matchers list Bash|PowerShell|Read|Grep|WebFetch + ctx_*. ADR-0009 journals Write/Edit rows and ADR-0016 needs Agent/subagent tool calls. With this matcher, PostToolUse never sees Write/Edit, so the 'changed files' section stays empty.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:103 'Matchers: `Bash|PowerShell|Read|Grep|WebFetch` + our own `ctx_*`'; adr/0009:36 '`edit`: Write/Edit file path, ok/fail'.
findings.fix: Split matchers per event in the adapter table: PreToolUse = Bash|Read|Grep|WebFetch; PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure = add Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit. Add a GP3 golden for an Edit journal row.

findings.claim: ADR-0009 adds PostToolUseFailure as a fifth Claude Code hook. ADR-0001, README §6, PRD §15.3 and doctor D3 ('4 hooks') all say 4 events, one native event each.
findings.evidence: adr/0009:44 'Claude Code also registers PostToolUseFailure'; adr/0001:13 'Events: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse'; adr/0010:30 'MCP entry, 4 hooks'; TECH-SPEC.md:219 '4 hook entries'.
findings.fix: State in ADR-0001 that canonical PostToolUse maps to two Claude Code events (PostToolUse + PostToolUseFailure), and update doctor D3 and the report row to 5 entries for Claude Code.

findings.claim: P4 says hooks do no DB work. ADR-0009 computes the compaction block inside the Claude Code SessionStart(compact) hook from context.db, and ADR-0008 Open measures it at 48.6 ms p95, over the 40 ms budget.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:23 'P4 Hooks are pure. No DB, no network, no spawn, ≤ 20 ms CPU.'; adr/0009:95 'computed inside SessionStart(compact)'; adr/0009:117 'SessionStart process is 48.6 ms p95'.
findings.fix: Either use an mcp_tool SessionStart hook for Claude Code (verify that mcp_tool is allowed on SessionStart) or rewrite P4 to allow a DB read in SessionStart, with its own budget.

findings.claim: v2 deletes the v1 cache-heal hook but no doc says how v2 handles the Claude Code plugin cache mismatch it was built for. No doctor check covers installed_plugins.json pointing to a missing dir.
findings.evidence: adr/0011:62 'Delete the cache-heal files'; grep for 46915/installed_plugins in docs/ and PRD: 0 hits; TECH-SPEC.md:217-227 doctor checks lack it.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY d08fe6a6 2026-04-26 'fix(cache): 4-layer self-heal for plugin cache mismatch (anthropics/claude-code#46915)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'Claude Code auto-update can leave installed_plugins.json pointing to a non-existent directory, breaking all hooks.' REGRESSION_RISK: after a v2 update all hooks silently stop. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no fallback or auto-heal (owner rule), so one doctor row must detect it and name the fix.
findings.fix: Add a doctor check: installed_plugins.json installPath exists and matches the running bundle; FAIL names `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode`. Check if anthropics/claude-code#46915 is fixed on 2.1.283 and cite it.

findings.claim: The deny message prints the exact host-prefixed tool name, but TECH-SPEC rule 1 and lint PR12 forbid prefixed names in model-visible text. Also, the Claude Code name differs between plain MCP and plugin; the doc does not say which one the adapter row holds.
findings.evidence: adr/0008:41 'Tool: <exact tool name for this agent>'; TECH-SPEC.md:201 'Lint PR12 fails on `mcp__…ctx_`'; TECH-SPEC.md:185-186 two Claude Code names.
findings.fix: Exempt hook deny text from PR12 in TECH-SPEC, and fix the Claude Code row to the plugin name (the only install mode, README §4).

findings.claim: ADR-0006 counts 7 tools; ADR-0007 and PRD addendum say 9 (doctor, upgrade kept); PRD:132 still says doctor/upgrade removed.
findings.evidence: adr/0006:37 'alwaysLoad on all 7 tools'; adr/0007:51 'returns the 9 tools'; PRD-v2.md:132 'Removed as tools: ctx_doctor, ctx_upgrade'; PRD-v2.md:289 '9 tools'; README.md:101 '7 tools'.
findings.fix: Use 9 everywhere (or 10 if ctx_route is listed) and recompute the always-in-context size in ADR-0006.
